verdict.rationale: Proa's own CLI has automation-friendly, non-interactive features. It offers `proa new site ... --yes` and `--no-agents-md` flags for unattended scaffolding, and check-style commands (`proa fmt --check --verify`, `--deny warnings`) that suit CI gating. Accessibility checks also run during cargo build and fail before deploy. However, nothing explicitly documents headless or CI usage, so CI fitness is inferred from these flags rather than stated. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (e.g., pipeline examples, exit-code semantics), documented non-interactive mode across all commands, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
